Centella Ampoule Foam is a gentle yet effective facial cleanser designed for sensitive and easily irritated skin. The formula is enriched with Centella Asiatica extract, known for its soothing, calming, and skin-repairing benefits. This cleanser creates a soft, creamy foam that removes dirt, oil, and impurities without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier. One of its standout features is how non-drying it is. Unlike many foaming cleansers that leave the skin feeling tight, this one maintains hydration while leaving the face feeling clean and refreshed. It's particularly helpful for people dealing with redness, sensitivity, or post-acne marks, as the Centella helps calm inflammation. The product has a light, clean scent (not overpowering) and rinses off easily without leaving any residue. With consistent use, skin tends to look smoother, calmer, and more balanced.

This is definitely a go to product for thoroughly cleansing while keeping your skin smooth and happy!

It's a nice foam cleanser. It's a thick formula and has a light scent. I have sensitive and combination skin and it made my face feel nice and hydrated. If you have sensitive, oily or acne prone skin try at your own discretion

avis.titre: Would definitely buy this one again
avis.texte: I love the cream i like being able to see all the areas the cleanser is just so I know I don't miss any spots. It's creamy and smooth going on. I have my daughter also using this with me and she's also love the way her face is clearing up and looking healty again

avis.titre: Perfect Foaming Cleanser to use after Oil Cleansing!
avis.texte: Beautiful rich foaming cleanser to use in conjunction with the centella cleansing oil! The formulation is perfect, with a pH of 5 and Centella Asiatica Extract, the skin is deeply cleansed without being harsh and stripping - leaving you with beautiful, clean and balanced skin!!

avis.titre: Vegan and unscented skincare for the win
avis.texte: I will preface this by saying it's slightly acidic so if you have sensitive skin, it can make your skin a little red even though it says on the box that it has been tested for skin irritants. It's got a lot of surfactants and really helps pull dirt and makeup to the surface of your skin to get it super clean, so I can deal with slight irritation plus following it up with the soothing cream helps with irritation! It's unscented which is great because I honestly hate scented skincare. I love these products a lot and I'm adding them into my regular rotation!

avis.titre: Now part of my daily skincare!
avis.texte: I received this for free in exchange for my review. This is now a permanent part of my skincare! This feels amazing on my skin. It doesn't really have a smell which I like. The ingredients are better than most. The packaging it comes in is beautiful. My skin hasn't been this good in a long time. It has helped to even out my skin tone a lot. It helps with makeup removal too.
